paragraphs.source_en: Within the newly completed castle, its eight-story keep thrust toward the heavens. The broad streets teemed with people, and among the fully armed arrivals entering the castle were countless palanquins bearing women. They were, of course, the hostages arriving one after another; some even entered on foot with children in tow. The magnificent halls and pavilions of Osaka Castle left them gaping in wonder and voicing their amazement.

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu had always conducted his affairs with extraordinary rigor, leaving no opening whatsoever; even the late Minister of the Right had been unable to find the slightest flaw in him. paragraphs.source_en: On the fourth day after leaving Osaka Castle—the twenty-fourth—Hideyoshi’s main force reached Gifu Castle.
